The Bahrain asset base this is built for

Bahrain is the historic cradle of Gulf oil and remains a critical downstream and aluminium hub, with the Bapco Modernisation Programme expanding Sitra refinery throughput to 380,000 bpd, ALBA Line 6 operating one of the world's largest single-site aluminium smelters, and Tatweer Petroleum running the legacy Awali field under enhanced oil recovery. The Bahrain National Oil & Gas Authority (NOGA) oversees integrity and HSE compliance across BAPCO, ALBA, GPIC (fertiliser), and Banagas LPG facilities, all clustered within 30 kilometres of Manama. Coastal saltwater corrosion and humidity drive aggressive external degradation, making digital twin coating-condition mapping a high-ROI deliverable for tank-farms, jetty structures, and the smelter pot-line gas-handling ducts.

How the twin is built

Capture the geometry (LiDAR, photogrammetry, drone survey, or import your existing BIM/CAD and isometrics), ingest inspection data over REST API or file drop from any instrument, overlay the governing damage mechanisms per API RP 571, then publish colour-coded remaining-life and RBI views to integrity, maintenance and planning. Records are retained audit-ready under ISO 9001, ISO 17020 and ISO 17025.

Integrations

SAP PM, Oracle eAM, IBM Maximo, ServiceNow, AVEVA PI, OSIsoft historians, Bentley iTwin, Cognite and Atlantis NDT ERP. Full REST API and bulk data export — you keep your data in a format you can leave with.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does Atlantis Digital Twin work in Bahrain?

We start with a 3D scan of your asset (drone, laser, photogrammetry), build a CAD-fidelity model, and then overlay every NDT inspection event (UT thickness readings, TOFD/PAUT scans, MT/PT indications, RT defect maps). Inspection data updates the model in real-time and colour-codes condition zones for engineering review. Operators in Bahrain use this to drive faster turnaround scoping, automated FFS evidence, and audit-grade regulatory reporting.

What does Digital Twin NDT cost in Bahrain?

Atlantis Digital Twin is an affordable, accessible, fully customizable enterprise SaaS platform sized for up to 500 assets, with ASNT Level III consulting and unlimited NDT data ingest included. Enterprise tiers are available for multi-site fleets, and on-prem deployment is offered at the same price point. Request a Bahrain-specific quote and we will model your asset count and data-volume requirements.

How long does deployment take in Bahrain?

A typical first-asset deployment runs 8-12 weeks: 2 weeks model build, 2 weeks data integration, 2-4 weeks workflow configuration, 2 weeks user training. Multi-asset rollouts are sequenced asset-by-asset after the first deployment is live, with each subsequent asset typically taking 4-6 weeks once the platform is configured for your Bahrain site.

Which NDT standards does the platform support in Bahrain?

API 510 (pressure vessels), API 570 (piping), API 653 (storage tanks), API 579 FFS, API 581 RBI, ASME Section V articles 2/4/6/7, ISO 9712 personnel qualification, ASNT SNT-TC-1A, and local code requirements depending on Bahrain's regulatory environment. Custom reporting templates can be configured for any additional national or operator-specific code.

Can Atlantis Digital Twin integrate with our existing CMMS in Bahrain?

Yes. We support REST API hooks for IBM Maximo, SAP PM, IFS, Oracle EAM, and most major CMMS platforms. Work-order creation, asset master sync, anomaly hand-off into corrective work, and FFS evidence packaging for management-of-change submittals can all be automated, allowing your Bahrain integrity team to focus on engineering judgement rather than data entry.
